correctness.rationale: Endomorphism images satisfy n equations f_i^m=0 in an n*m^n coordinate affine scheme; invertibility on the full algebra is open, giving Aut as open subscheme. Differentiating (x_i+epsilon h_i)^m gives m x_i^(m-1)h_i; its rank is m^(n-1) for each generator if p does not divide m, zero if p divides m, yielding tangent dimensions. If m invertible, substitutions f_i=x_i u_i with arbitrary units give a smooth family through identity of full tangent dimension; regular local dimension and base-field descent imply group-scheme smoothness. If p|m, geometric automorphisms preserve the unique maximal ideal, so all constant coefficients vanish and dimension<=n(m^n-1)<nm^n tangent; this proves nonsmoothness. For p^e||m infinitesimal translations by a_i^(p^e)=0 preserve x_i^m and invert. If m=p^e, Frobenius makes every zero-constant generator image m-nilpotent, so an invertible cotangent matrix plus arbitrary higher coefficients proves full finite-field point count and reduced dimension. Independent 80 tangent dimension cases and small finite-field formula examples confirmed; no claim these finite tests prove all fields.
residual_risks: The finite-field count is only asserted when m itself is a p-power.
The full reduced scheme is not classified in p-divisible composite exponents.

value.rationale: Scheme-theoretic smoothness is invisible in the group of field-valued automorphisms and governs infinitesimal deformation. The sharp arithmetic p|m boundary in an infinite natural box-truncated complete-intersection family, precise tangent dimension jump and explicit alpha_(p^e)^n obstruction extend the already-known m=p phenomenon; exact p-power finite-field counts are supporting structure. This is a natural classification, not arbitrary low-n recomputation.
residual_risks: The finite prime-height subcase is prior and contributes value only as an acknowledged base case; generalized statement is the meaningful component.

final_claim: For any field k and n,m>=2, the full automorphism affine group scheme of A=k[x_1,...,x_n]/(x_i^m) is smooth exactly if char k does not divide m (including characteristic zero). Its tangent dimension is n(m-1)m^(n-1) if m invertible and nm^n if p|m; in latter case it contains alpha_(p^e)^n where p^e is the largest p-power dividing m. If k=F_q and m=p^e, the automorphism count is |GL_n(q)| q^[n(m^n-n-1)], and the reduced group dimension is n(m^n-1).
limitations: Full affine group scheme, n,m>=2, arbitrary field; composite m and characteristic p dividing m reduced group not classified.
